player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Simbolo mo so '{symbol}', tan numero'y iyong galaw ay laging {parity} (pian, X1, X3 o O2, O4).

Tantya: Manalo ka ba'y panggawa'y linea na taloran classical marks (solidified from superpositions).

Panon ton Galaw:
- Ton kada turno, iteg'y spooky mark ed duaran baleg a squares a usaren to'y format '[a,b]'.
- Sarayan marks so entangled, tan labeled a singa 'X1 / X1' o 'O4 / O4'.
- Agka'y amta'y panggawa'y spooky marks ed square ya agni'y nacollapse (solidified).

Regla'y Collapse:
- No'n galaw mo so panggawa'y cycle ed entanglement graph, say collapse so automatic.
- Kada spooky mark ed cycle so manayam ed classical mark ed sakey na duaran posisyon to.
- Aman dependent spooky marks so collapse met.

Victory:
- Say palaro so matapos no'n sakey a managpapat so taloran classical marks ed sakey a linea.
- No'n duaran managpapat so nacollapse ed sakey a linea, say managpapat so mas baba'y max galaw numero so manalo.

Pian a galaw: '[0,4]' so panggawa'y spooky mark ed cells 0 tan 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aliwan balido so format. Usaren so "[a,b]".
invalid_move.invalid_cells: Aliwan dugaruga odino duplikado iray index na selula.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Sakey ed saray selula so nagmaliw lan mapekder.

game_action.placed: Say player {player_id} so angiyakar ed simbolo to diad superposition na selula ya {pos_a} tan {pos_b} .

game_message.dependent_resolved: Superposition ya dependent so nalutas. Cell ({r}, {c}) so natan ed {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Naresolba so superposition para last cell. Cell ({r}, {c}) et ngayon {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Naresolba so superposition. Cell ({r}, {c}) et ngayon {symbol}.

outcome.win: Manalo so {player_id} ya man-player a walaan na saray marking!
